player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Bad Player''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.

starting.card: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince

description: The deck that I've been playing since 2 weeks after R2 was released. Used to win the GA state championship.
cards: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince
Wakeelmui/Kuat (Kuat at states, wakeelmui every other time)
posted: Wakeelmui/Kuat (Kuat at states, wakeelmui every other time)
notes: The post has no starting section; the opening block lists AOBS, Coruscant, Cor Imp City, Cor DB, Death Star DB and Wakeelmui/Kuat. Starting objective Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince and Prepared Defenses (listed with the Interrupts) count toward the 60; no starting Effect is named.

The description says the deck won the Georgia (GA) state championship; the strategy says this is the list played there after last-minute changes (added 2 Emperors, I Have You Now, Bad Feeling Have I; removed Vigo, Snoova, Put All Sections On Alert, Executor DB).
Posted 'Wakeelmui/Kuat (Kuat at states, wakeelmui every other time)' is one slot naming two systems; kept as written (Kuat at states).

Posted 'Coruscant' dested Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition); 'Cor Imp City' Coruscant: Imperial City; 'Cor DB' Coruscant: Docking Bay (Dark); 'Death Star DB' Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'IAO' Imperial Arrest Order (Special Edition Effect).

Posted 'IG with gun', '4LOM with gun', 'Fett with gun' and 'Dengar with gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun, 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle and Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Fett in ship', 'Bossk in bus', 'Zuckuss in ship' dested Boba Fett In Slave I, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.
Secret Plans and No Escape were Effects in 2001, not Defensive Shields; no shields are posted.
Emperor Palpatine x5 and Prince Xizor x2 are kept as published although unique.
player_note: The post lists Wakeelmui/Kuat in one slot and says Kuat was played at the state championship and Wakeelmui every other time.
